method: Web research by two research agents in one Claude Code session: one on Anthropic's own documentation, launch pages and system cards, one on independent benchmarks. Every figure below was read from the page named in its source, fetched on 2026-09-28. Models as resolved by Claude Code 2.1.283: haiku = claude-haiku-4-5, sonnet = claude-sonnet-5, opus = claude-opus-5-5.

claude-sonnet-5.conflict: https://artificialanalysis.ai/articles/claude-sonnet-5-agentic-cost (2026-06-30) says $2/$10 was promotional until September 1 and the standard price is $3/$15. Unresolved.

artificialAnalysis.caveat: Every Opus 5.5 entry is labelled 'Adaptive Reasoning, X Effort, Default Fallback'; AA does not explain 'fallback'. Vals.ai describes Anthropic fallback rows as provider-side fallback (see vals below).

anthropicSweBenchProSubset.note: 478 problems; Anthropic says it is not comparable to the public leaderboard. Vendor data.
quotes: On SWE-bench Pro, measured against `high`, Claude Opus 5.5 scored about 2.5 points lower at its default, `medium`, for about 70% of the cost, and about 8 points lower at `low` for about a third of the cost; `xhigh` scored about 1.4 points higher for 2.5 times the cost of `high`.
With Claude Opus 5.5 at `low`, 13% of tasks failed; with those re-run at `high`, about 97% passed for about $0.17 each, against 95.3% for $0.29 running everything at `high`.

anthropicOther.quote: Sonnet 5 ... Low effort: ... Suitable for chat and non-coding use cases. ... Xhigh effort: For the hardest coding and agentic tasks.
Claude Sonnet 5 at medium is comparable in intelligence to Claude Sonnet 4.6 at high, and Claude Sonnet 5 at high is comparable to Claude Sonnet 4.6 at max.
Claude Opus 5.5 at `medium` matches or exceeds Claude Opus 5 at `high` on coding and knowledge-work evaluations, and on several coding evaluations `low` comes close to it at much lower cost.
CursorBench 4.0: 57.8% at max effort, 56.0% at xhigh and high, and 52.5% at medium.
Haiku 4.5 retirement: Not sooner than October 15, 2026.

favoringSonnet.note: Tasks 2026-05-15 to 2026-07-01. Sonnet 5 at high resolved 56.8% at $1.43 per problem; Opus 5 (not 5.5) at high 63.4% at $3.47. No Opus 5.5 entry.
Sonnet 5 (Claude Code, xhigh) 88.20; Opus 5 (not 5.5) 98.00; Haiku 4.5 25.50. No Opus 5.5 entry, no costs.

vals.note: Terminal-Bench 4.0: Opus 5.5 (max) 61.62%, 53.54% without fallback; Sonnet 5 (effort not stated) 8.08%. 'Four Anthropic rows include provider-side fallback.'

gaps: No third-party SWE-bench results split by effort level for Sonnet 5 or Opus 5.5.
Anthropic publishes no Sonnet 5 results by effort level in text.
No direct measurement of Sonnet 5 at xhigh against Opus 5.5 at low on SWE-bench-style tasks.
